title: Sampler band with five stitches
subtitle: A horizontal band that practises five stitches in sequence
excerpt: A sampler band works five different stitches in parallel rows across a piece of fabric, building a visual record of what each stitch looks like while practising them all in one session.
heroPrompt: A five-row stitch sampler band on cream linen, each horizontal row a different stitch in a different thread colour, framed in a hoop, natural light.

content.text: A sampler band gives five stitches the same treatment: one row each, worked across the full width of the fabric from left to right. Each row uses a different thread colour so the stitches read clearly against each other. The finished piece is a reference as well as practice.

items.label: Fabric
items.value: Natural linen or cotton, 25 x 18 cm

items.label: Thread
items.value: 5 colours of stranded cotton, 2 to 3 strands each

items.label: Hoop
items.value: 15 cm embroidery hoop, used as a moving hoop to access different parts

content.text: Draw 5 horizontal guide lines across the fabric, about 2 cm apart.
Work row 1 in stem stitch along the first line.
Work row 2 in chain stitch along the second line.
Work row 3 in herringbone stitch between two guide lines.
Work row 4 in feather stitch, centred on the fourth guide line.
Work row 5 in blanket stitch along the fifth line.
Remove guide lines. Label each row on the reverse in pencil for future reference.
Swap in different stitches as you learn more. The band grows with your practice.
